events.description: A bright flash and sudden intense illumination from the front, consistent with a head-on collision or severe impact involving vehicle headlights and possible airbag deployment or debris; the scene immediately darkens afterward, suggesting loss of power or camera disruption.

A sudden bright flash and rapidly expanding fireball with sparks and smoke erupts near a parked vehicle on the right side of the street, consistent with an explosion. The light intensifies over several frames and illuminates surrounding structures and wet pavement.

A dark SUV appears to collide with or strike a stationary object (possibly another vehicle or barrier) at the intersection, immediately preceding the explosion. The vehicle’s position shifts abruptly between f4 and f5, and debris/sparks begin appearing at f5, suggesting impact-initiated event.

A bright, intense flash and rapidly expanding fireball with sparks and smoke erupts near a parked vehicle in a dark street, consistent with a high-energy explosion (e.g., gas or fuel ignition). The event initiates at f0 (24.0 s) and evolves through f12 (30.0 s), with visible debris/sparks and illumination of the scene.

A vehicle (likely the one on the right) appears to be involved in a sudden impact or loss of control immediately before or concurrent with the explosion; its position shifts abruptly between f0 and f2, and it is stationary but angled abnormally by f2, suggesting a collision occurred just prior to or simultaneous with the blast.
A white car collides with the side of a blue bus at an intersection, causing visible impact and debris/sparks; the bus is pushed sideways.
A white car collides with a blue bus at an intersection, causing visible impact and debris/sparks; the white car is pushed sideways and comes to rest near the bus.
After the initial collision, the white car remains stationary near the blue bus while smoke/dust rises from the impact zone; the green truck begins to maneuver around the scene.
A green truck on the left makes a sharp turn and collides with a white van crossing the intersection; the van is visibly struck and displaced.
Immediately after the initial impact, the white van is pushed into the path of a blue bus, resulting in a secondary collision between the van and the bus.
A motorcycle lies on its side in the intersection, having collided with a white car; the bus is stopped nearby, suggesting an immediate aftermath of a crash.

A dark-colored car collides with orange construction barriers on the left side of the road, causing a visible burst of debris and smoke/fire at impact; the vehicle comes to an abrupt stop against the barriers.
